hypotheses.claim: In the L3 ruin-recreate skeleton (CW + intra_2opt build, deterministic Regret-2 reinsertion, intra_2opt per perturbed route, R2R acceptance), the mean tour length on cvrp_dev_hetero_24 at 500 ms is dominated by two controllable factors in score_ruin_nodes: (a) a load-utilization gate that preferentially destroys customers on under-filled routes (where removal_savings underestimates reinsertion gains), and (b) a rank-power exponent p that is high (p~2) in the early iter_frac regime to focus on the most removable customers and decays toward p~1 (or below) as stagnation_ratio crosses ~0.5 to diversify. Because Regret-2 reinsertion already exploits detour savings greedily, adding depot-distance and demand gates mostly injects noise; ablating them is expected to be neutral-to-positive.

next_search_advice.direction: Evolve the multiplicative gated rank-power ruin priority score: seed the population with worst-removal (rank_power p=1, all gates=1) and with load/depot-balanced variants, then evolve gate exponents and a stagnation/iter_frac-adaptive rank power that concentrates on high removal savings early and diversifies (spatial-adjacency relatedness proxy) when stagnation_ratio rises.
